The '''1940-41 Serie A''' was the forty-first edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]] and its twelfth since [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]] re-[[brand]]ing to create [[Serie A]]. It was the eighteenth season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[Bologna F.C. 1909|Bologna]] were champions for the sixth time in their [[history]]. This was their sixth scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their fourth win contested as Serie A. This completed the twice [[Internazionale|Ambrosiana-Inter]] punctuated run of four Bologna wins from six consecutive Serie A competitions.
[[Image:Serie A (football) 1940-41.png|thumb|325px|right|Serie A 1940-41 teams distribution]]

==Teams==
[[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]] and [[AS Livorno|Livorno]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
